problem: Monday starts with a blank page and a full inbox.

points.heading: List what must ship
points.detail: Write down only the work with a deadline this week.

points.heading: Block time for deep work
points.detail: Put focus time on the calendar before meetings fill it.

points.heading: Leave room for surprises
points.detail: Keep part of every day unplanned.

points.heading: Review on Friday
points.detail: Move what slipped, and note why.
